module.purpose: Defines the core TypeScript type contracts for an entity adapter pattern (normalized state CRUD, selectors, factory) used by a Redux Toolkit-style state library.
module.summary: This file is a pure type-definition module that establishes the shape and contracts for managing normalized entity collections. It declares primitive type aliases such as EntityId, Comparer, IdSelector, and Update, plus interfaces describing the entity state container, adapter options, the full mutating operation surface (add/set/remove/update/upsert variants accepting either raw values or PayloadAction), read-only selectors, a state factory, and the composed adapter. All constructs are compile-time only; there is no runtime logic, making it the shared schema that dependent implementation modules must satisfy.
module.businessContext:
Provides the typing foundation for normalized state management in a frontend state library.
Critical for type-safe CRUD operations on collections.
Breaking changes cause compile errors across all dependent modules.

contractsProvided.name: Comparer
contractsProvided.shape: export type Comparer<T> = (a: T, b: T) => number

contractsProvided.name: IdSelector
contractsProvided.shape: export type IdSelector<T, Id extends EntityId> = (model: T) => Id

contractsProvided.name: Update
contractsProvided.shape: export type Update<T, Id extends EntityId> = { id: Id; changes: Partial<T> }

contractsProvided.name: EntityState
contractsProvided.shape: export interface EntityState<T, Id extends EntityId> { ids: Id[]; entities: Record<Id, T> }

contractsProvided.name: EntityAdapterOptions
contractsProvided.shape: export interface EntityAdapterOptions<T, Id extends EntityId> { selectId?: IdSelector<T, Id>; sortComparer?: false | Comparer<T> }

contractsProvided.name: EntityStateAdapter
contractsProvided.shape: export interface EntityStateAdapter<T, Id extends EntityId> { addOne; addMany; setOne; setMany; setAll; removeOne; removeMany; removeAll; updateOne; updateMany; upsertOne; upsertMany }

contractsProvided.name: EntitySelectors
contractsProvided.shape: export interface EntitySelectors<T, V, IdType extends EntityId> { selectIds: (state: V) => IdType[]; selectEntities: (state: V) => Record<IdType, T>; selectAll: (state: V) => T[]; selectTotal: (state: V) => number; selectById: (state: V, id: IdType) => Id<UncheckedIndexedAccess<T>> }

contractsProvided.name: EntityStateFactory
contractsProvided.shape: export interface EntityStateFactory<T, Id extends EntityId> { getInitialState(state?: undefined, entities?: Record<Id, T> | readonly T[]): EntityState<T, Id>; getInitialState<S extends object>(state: S, entities?: Record<Id, T> | readonly T[]): EntityState<T, Id> & S }

contractsProvided.name: EntityAdapter
contractsProvided.shape: export interface EntityAdapter<T, Id extends EntityId> extends EntityStateAdapter<T, Id>, EntityStateFactory<T, Id>, Required<EntityAdapterOptions<T, Id>> { getSelectors(selectState?: undefined, options?: GetSelectorsOptions): EntitySelectors<T, EntityState<T, Id>, Id>; getSelectors<V>(selectState: (state: V) => EntityState<T, Id>, options?: GetSelectorsOptions): EntitySelectors<T, V, Id> }
